description: Manage per-entity evidence, reconciled belief stances, the perception ledger, and a one-entity knowledge query. admit records a subject/predicate/object proposition with a 0..1 weight and does not change a stance until reconcile recomputes it; retract removes the cited evidence and reconciles; the perception ledger is append-only, so correct a mistaken perception with a new record. Mutating actions persist to the Novel; reads are read-only. knowledge_query returns perceptions, beliefs, and known secrets with event provenance, optionally filtered by topic. Use when: inspecting or recording what an entity learned or believes. Do NOT use when: recording objective truth — use manage_causality; recording shared lore — use manage_lore.

action.description: Belief: list, get, evidence, admit, retract, conflicts, or reconcile. Perception ledger: perception_record, perception_list, perception_for_entity, or perception_for_event. Knowledge: knowledge_query.

detail.description: Return full belief records instead of summary entries (list).

entity_id.description: Entity whose beliefs are queried or mutated.

perception_event_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal (perception_record/perception_for_event; defaults to the latest event).

perception_kind.description: message, scene, or observation (perception_record; default observation).

perception_room_id.description: Room identifier for the perception (perception_record; defaults to the entity's room).

perception_sense.description: Sense that produced the perception (perception_record; default null; REQ-594).

perception_source_entity.description: Entity the perception came from (perception_record; default null).

source.description: Source key used to correlate duplicate evidence (admit; default the active badge).

source_ordinal.description: Contributing event-log ordinal (admit; default the latest event ordinal).

status.description: active, unresolved, or suppressed (admit; default active).

topic.description: Optional topic filter applied to knowledge_query perceptions, beliefs, and secrets.

name: manage_belief

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Belief Management
